title: Final Coverage Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for coverage as a function of temperature and pressure.

title: Grand Canonical Partition Function
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the Grand Canonical partition function for a single adsorption site correctly.

title: Chemical Potential Relation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly relate the chemical potential of the ideal gas to the coverage expression.

title: Mathematical Derivation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student should show clear and logical steps in the derivation process leading to the final answer.

title: Correct Use of Variables
description: Optional Criteria: The student should use the correct definitions and values for variables such as n_Q and lambda throughout the solution.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check for consistency in units throughout the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the final expression.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss limiting cases or special scenarios that validate the derived expression.
